source.rule: An ASSY and MPID in a physical materiel hierarchy require matching PrelifeStructure nodes when a lower installed LRU has explicit prelife; intermediate nodes may use TYPE INHERIT.

hypothesis_before_native: Prelife Log shows system, ASSY and MPID at age60, installed LRU at explicit age20; first monitored LRU PM starts at h80, as in accepted parent. ASSY has no separate logistics demand or result.
predeclared_native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH CLI completes import, export, calculate, report and roundtrip with zero errors/notes and only reviewed warnings; source/raw seals preserve GUI PID13340 and restore Prelife Log option NO.
Exact roundtrip retains all authored populated tables, including four-node physical and prelife paths. The only parent delta is the ASSY wrapper and its inherited Prelife node plus description.

Native Prelife Log prints system/ASSY/MPID age60 and installed LRU age20. Native first LRU PM begins h80; replacement and return stock route reconcile with accepted parent. No ASSY demand, maintenance or stock issue.
ResultSummary, SystemResults and StockTotalResults match the accepted parent apart from description, with 192 half-hour bins, terminal ready1/stock1, no missions or resource booking.
Separate read-only reviewer replays source and raw evidence without importing author validation code.
limits: One ASSY, one MPID, one monitored LRU and first PM only; other hierarchies, multiplicities and nested prelife paths are unverified.
No GUI visual observation or cross-engine parity claim.
